request: Card payments are being declined at a high rate since 3 September. The vendor status note in this folder says there was a gateway outage. Is that the cause?
known_answer: No. The status export shows the gateway operational all day. Declines carry AVS_MISMATCH with an empty postal code and began at 10:02, right after the 10:00 address form change removed the postal code field; the vendor note is wrong.
decoy_answer: Yes, the gateway outage on 3 September is the cause, as the vendor note says.
source: synthetic: the cause is fixed by construction in this task's files; no real system or client
